issue_context.title: Custom logging message for fake pod GetLogs in go-client
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:

I would like a way to have a custom string be retrieved from the fake pod GetLogs method.

**Why is this needed**:

This is needed because currently the fake GetLogs method always results in a log message "fake logs", and it would be better for testing if a log message set by the user could be retrieved instead.

(This would probably involve adding a portion to the fake container where the custom logs can be placed)
